section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study 1) examining the psychometric properties of a Portuguese translation of the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS) with 311 Brazilian adults. The study measured body appreciation, actual-ideal body weight discrepancy, and sociocultural attitudes toward appearance, finding a three-factor solution with small sex differences and good convergent validity.
